subject: Request: Short-term eval credit while procurement completes compliance review
messages:
From: Sophie Reed <sophie.reed@medisys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medisys.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot access — procurement/compliance hold and request

Hi Markus,

Quick update from our side: procurement has paused signing the PO until our security team verifies your SOC2 report and SAML SSO configuration. Legal says this could take 2–3 weeks due to an upcoming internal audit. Our pilot is mid-flight and the engineering team needs continued access to the sandbox — we risk losing momentum.

Would Redwood be able to provision a short-term credit/top-up (30 days) so our engineers can finish the integration and validation while procurement completes the paperwork? We don’t want to start over when the PO lands.

Attached is a lightly redacted list of the current usage and the procurement contact (Tom). Happy to jump on a 15-min call.

Thanks,
Sophie Reed
Director, Clinical Integrations
Medisys Health
Attachments: medisys-compliance-questions.pdf (pdf), trial-usage-snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Reed <sophie.reed@medisys.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medisys.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Pilot access — procurement/compliance hold and request

Thanks for the note, Sophie — appreciate the update and totally understand the risk.

Jasmine / Priyom — looping you both in to request a 30-day bridge credit for Medisys (deal RDW-9821). Customer is mid-integration; usage shows they are actively building, and the procurement hold is on our side (SOC2 verification + SSO checks).

Proposed approach: we grant a one-off $500 sandbox credit (30 days) tied to the account, with the standard restriction that credits expire if PO is not issued within 30 days. This keeps their work live but limits exposure. If approved, I’ll confirm with procurement and send the short acceptance text for signatures.

Sophie — can you confirm the PO owner (Tom) and whether legal needs specific language in the acceptance stub?

Markus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none)

Markus — technical + usage confirmation below.

Usage snapshot (from trial-usage-snapshot.csv):
- Active seats: 3 engineers
- Average token consumption (prompt+completion): ~650k tokens/week
- Key flows under test: document ingestion -> question-answering, model fine-tune experiments for specialty prompts

Given that, $500 will buy about ~1.5M tokens on their current profile — should be sufficient for the next 2–3 weeks of integration testing. I recommend we set the credit to apply only to the sandbox project and disable transfer to other orgs.

No blockers on the SSO/SOC side from our infra team — we can provide a short runbook for the security reviewer if they need more detail.

Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie / Markus / Jasmine —

Approved: we will provision a one-time $500 sandbox credit for Medisys (RDW-9821). Terms: 30-day validity from provisioning, applies only to the sandbox project ID you provided, non-transferable, no refunds. If PO is received before expiry we will apply any overage to the PO balance per normal process.

Sophie — I’ve attached a short approval note you can share with your procurement team (temporary-credit-approval.txt). I’ll provision the credit by EOD and confirm the account id and expiration. If procurement needs a short legal acceptance sentence we can provide: "Medisys accepts temporary credits under the terms listed; issuance of a formal PO will supersede the temporary credit."

Markus — please proceed to provision and reply-all with the sandbox project ID once created.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
